about: The Nexus Mods downloads the HD Texture Pack is built from (plans/pc-enhancements.md 2.1, B9.1), in pack order: later sources win where they change the same texture. Picture files only; scripts/picture_gate.py checks every file. sha256 and size are the files the pack was made with; a different one (an update on Nexus) is reported and still checked.

sources.why: Left out unless asked for (--include ARM): with it, lamp travel stalled on the loading screen (every long test run, into or out of Forbidden Woods) and arrivals hitched up to 230 ms; the hunter's 4x armour is reloaded at every area change. The pack without it passed 24 travels.
